jobs.title: Agentic Security Platform Complete AI protection
jobs.description: Salt’s Agentic Security Platform™ makes your Agentic risk visible — before it becomes a problem Agents drive innovation, but they also introduce unseen risk. Salt's Agentic Security Platform™ gives you full visibility and control, so you can reduce risk, meet compliance, and stay resilient. Book a demo Get Buyer's Guide Instant clarity into your Agentic Security Graph Your Agent Security Graph is the interconnected mesh of APIs that powers your operations, applications, and digital experiences. It’s constantly evolving, and without visibility, it becomes your largest source of risk. One platform. Three agentic capabilities. AG-SPM (Agentic Security Posture Management) Know every agent, MCP server, and model in your environment, and govern what they're allowed to do. Agents get built faster than security can track them. Salt continuously discovers the agentic lifecycle from code to runtime, mapping the relationships between LLMs, MCP servers, and the APIs they invoke into a live Agentic Security Graph. Shadow MCP servers surface. Over-permissioned agents get caught. Every autonomous interaction stays traceable and auditable against frameworks like the EU AI Act, NIST, and SOC 2. What it means for you: Eliminate shadow AI and shadow MCP Keep every agent inside its intended business boundary Prove AI governance to auditors and the board Govern your agentic posture AI-DR (AI Detection and Response) ‍Catch abuse of the model layer, not just the traffic around it. Prompt injection, context poisoning, and sensitive data leaking through model interactions never show up as a malformed request. Salt inspects how models are actually being used in production, flagging jailbreak attempts, unsanctioned model access, and PII moving into and out of LLM calls. You see what your models are exposed to, and what they're exposing. What it means for you: Stop prompt injection and context manipulation Prevent sensitive data loss through model interactions Keep unsanctioned AI out of production Secure your AI layer AG-DR (Agentic Detection and Response) ‍Stop agents acting outside of their intent, at machine speed. Agent behavior is non-deterministic, so static signatures and rate limits do not apply. Salt establishes agentic-aware baselines and correlates 100% of traffic back to a unique agentic identity, performing Identity-Aware Intent Analysis to catch mass data pulls, unauthorized tool usage, and logic-based abuse that packet inspection misses. Attacks running at machine speed get interrupted with automated, real-time blocking. What it means for you: Detect malicious intent, not just known signatures Tell legitimate agents from malicious bots Block machine-speed attacks in real time Stop agentic attacks Built for your stack. Ready for your workflows. Illuminate integrates seamlessly into the tools your teams already rely on, so you can enforce API security without introducing friction. Whether you’re enriching alerts in your SIEM, closing gaps through Jira tickets, or blocking attacks at your firewall, Illuminate makes your stack smarter and your teams faster. REPORT 1H 2026 The State of AI and API Security Report The State of AI and API Security Report uncovers the growing security gap in the agentic AI era. Learn why APIs have become the foundation of AI. Download now EBOOK AI & API Security For Dummies This eBook walks you through the evolution of application architecture, why APIs are now essential, and how the rapid rise of AI is transforming both their value and their risk profile. Download eBook GUIDE Agentic Security Buyers Guide This buyer’s guide helps security leaders understand what’s changed, what’s at risk, and how to evaluate solutions built for the agentic AI era. Get the guide Trusted by global enterprises to illuminate their API fabric Let Salt illuminate your entire API fabric Don’t wait for a breach to discover what you should have seen all along. Illuminate makes your API Fabric visible, governable, and secure. jobs.title: Salt Surface Map external exposure
jobs.description: See your API attack surface — the way attackers do With zero traffic collection needed, Salt Surface gives you an outside-in view of your public API exposure, without deploying a single agent. Fast. Easy. Problem framing: Your organization likely has hundreds of APIs exposed to the internet, and many you don’t even know exist. Traditional tools can’t find them because they don’t speak API. Shadow, rogue, and forgotten APIs become the easiest way in for attackers. Solution overview: Salt Surface uses external reconnaissance, just like an adversary, to continuously map your API exposure. Unlike CNAPPs or traditional attack surface tools that focus on IPs and DNS records, Salt Surface is purpose-built for APIs. And it's 100% agentless.
